categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Changes core PSBT data structure logic in src/psbt.cpp, not RPC server infrastructure or interface definitions.
categories.rationale: Does not belong to RPC; the behavior exposed by joinpsbts belongs to PSBT and wallet handling rather than the RPC interface machinery.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Modifies PSBT input handling in src/psbt.cpp to fix signing breakage in walletprocesspsbt and finalizepsbt.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug where joining PSBTs with Taproot inputs leaves stale signatures, causing walletprocesspsbt and finalizepsbt to fail to complete the transaction without manual PSBT editing.
